Snappy - 1 to 4 September

Published
6 September 2026
Tagged
weeknote

A little week with just 3 days of work, so let’s keep this snappy.

This week

This week, I have:

  • moved my non-working day so we could take Kid A to Gulliver’s Valley with their friends before first ever days of school - such a fun day out and the school start seems to have gone well too, phew
  • finished up (almost) all of the documentation following the latest update to the Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework
  • planned the content change work for this month’s sprint cycle - with the understanding that things will likely need re-prioritising or pushing back because of site migration
  • got back to testing the rebuilt site frontend and our new CMS - getting closer, just a couple of chunky things remaining to work on with the dev, such as search and feedback components
  • chatted briefly again with fellow content designers and information architects about ‘how to fix all the GDS guidance things’ - this involved a convoluted analogy based on the council scene from LOTR which I swear was helpful in the moment
  • a couple of sessions thinking deeply about how we might change ‘skills’ to make things better for the profession and government - great discussions with our team and capability leads from around gov
  • more notes and ideas for my SDinGov session - I absolutely have to start putting the slides together next week, or else
  • walked the new service owner through every step of the current governance and co-design processes that effectively form our ‘change the framework’ service - we’ve started a really detailed diagram, yey!
  • struggled with some recruitment and HR fun - nuff said
  • checked on signups for the next X-Gov Sheffield meetup, and happily we’ve already hit our unofficial target - you can still sign up to join us for breakfast and coffee on 17 September

Next week

Next week I’m looking forward to:

  • getting in to some design work for both the site and upcoming content changes
  • a proper away day in Manchester with the wider team - always nice to see everyone in person
  • a hackathon in Sheffield exploring ‘how better use of information could help identify and help children who need support earlier’

Reading and listening

  • Gateshead revisited - Andy Parker
  • 1-800-PODCAST - 99% Invisible
  • Sometimes you just need to sit down and do the boring, time-consuming job - Ray Newman
